Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.467.0/aosward-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosward-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne '8f1661f2551a0e81bcd84a61fb338c2dc1215d9b33cfadf8271f9867596ffb3d') { throw 'aosward checksum mismatch' }

Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://github.com/coilyco/agentic-os/releases/download/aos-v0.467.0/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe' -OutFile "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe"; if ((Get-FileHash "$dir/aosguard-windows-amd64.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne 'bd1b80d8bc412a8cae12ea0b574b5a074f285a5e3842ca44aa6bf05c43d6e8a4') { throw 'aosguard checksum mismatch' }
